parameters.content:
## ATS jobs → Airtable
Pull the newest Greenhouse job postings (last 7 days, max 10) into Airtable. Same pattern works for Lever, Ashby and SmartRecruiters by changing the Actor slug.

1. Replace `YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN` on the Apify node.
2. Replace `YOUR_AIRTABLE_TOKEN`, `YOUR_AIRTABLE_BASE_ID` and `YOUR_AIRTABLE_TABLE` on the Airtable node.
3. Create Airtable fields: Title, Company, Location, Department, URL, Posted, Source.
4. Edit `companies` / `since` and click Test workflow.

Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/greenhouse-jobs-scraper
Also: lever-jobs-scraper, ashby-jobs-scraper, smartrecruiters-jobs-scraper
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/greenhouse-jobs-scraper

nodes.name: Run Greenhouse Jobs Scraper on Apify
nodes.notes: Replace YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN with your Apify API token. To use Lever, Ashby or SmartRecruiters instead, change the Actor slug in the URL (publicrecords~lever-jobs-scraper, publicrecords~ashby-jobs-scraper, or publicrecords~smartrecruiters-jobs-scraper) and the company tokens. Runs bill to your own Apify account. maxResults is 10 so the Airtable request stays within one batch of 10 records.

nodes.name: Create rows in Airtable
nodes.notes: Replace YOUR_AIRTABLE_TOKEN, YOUR_AIRTABLE_BASE_ID and YOUR_AIRTABLE_TABLE. Create matching fields in the table: Title, Company, Location, Department, URL, Posted, Source. Airtable allows up to 10 records per request.
